fantasypros.url_template: https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/{qb|rb|wr|te|k|dst}.php?week=6&scoring={PPR|HALF|STD}; ECR rank from https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/{[ppr-|half-point-ppr-]rb|wr|te, qb, k, dst}.php?week=6
fantasypros.note: Projections pages show only the top 10 rows per position to anonymous users (a registration fence hides the rest; not bypassed), so proj_pts is set only for those. rank = FantasyPros Week 6 expert consensus (ECR) positional rank from the public rankings pages (full lists, in-page ecrData). 1239 ECR-only rows have proj_pts null (stats.ecr_r2p_pts = ECR feed's r2p_pts, meaning unverified). QB/K/DST ECR is one list shared by all formats; RB/WR/TE ECR is per format.
